money: raw integer strings, six decimals; settings in the household profile's own units
about: A leaving household: its insured asset is sold (the price pays arrears and the whole mortgage), its working balance and basket receipts come home, its whole lien is retired with owned and then bought BUCK, coverage no principal needs is released, the BUCK left are sold a capped bite a day, and it leaves. An investor only redeems, sells and leaves. Read by the Python and JavaScript suites.

saver.about: a carry line invested for two days, a working balance bought on the first payday, then the sale on day three

debtor.about: one refinance tranche, then the sale: the price pays the whole mortgage; the lien is bought back a bite a day

investor.about: at BVIB near 1 dollars go to the basket; after a broad sell-off raises BVIB beyond its 1% tolerance it buys and holds BUCK; when BVIB returns it deposits them; all is withdrawn at the horizon

release.about: coverage activated with no premium and nothing drawn: only burn(0) can release it

flow.about: one real exit per case, as the saver above; refused = the same send with one bound made unreachable. Cases marked js: false run in Python only, to bound the Tevm run.

cases.name: lost redemption reply is booked once
closed exit door waits and is counted once a day
lost sale reply is applied once
no dollars left is a shortfall, not an exit
